title: Physics & Cosmology — Literal Reference Atlas
purpose: Give project comparators a compact literal physics owner so terms such as event horizon, T-duality, mirror symmetry, M-theory and Saturn hexagon cannot float free of their actual scientific domains.
epistemic_rule: A valid analogy preserves the literal mechanism and states the mismatch. A borrowed term is not evidence that the project object shares the physics.

entries.literal: In general-relativistic black-hole physics, the event horizon is a causal boundary: inside it, signals cannot escape to distant outside observers. It is not a solid surface.
entries.project_boundary: A difficult personal or symbolic threshold is not an event horizon unless an actual spacetime causal boundary is being claimed and modeled.

entries.literal: General relativity predicts singular behavior at the center of idealized black-hole solutions. NASA explicitly notes that whether the singularity is a physical structure or a mathematical indication of the theory's limit remains unknown; quantum effects absent from classical relativity may matter.
entries.project_boundary: Use singularity as a methodological analogy for model breakdown only when clearly labeled; contradiction or psychological rupture is not literally gravitational singularity.

entries.literal: Cassini observations show a long-lived six-sided atmospheric jet stream around Saturn's north pole, about 30,000 km across with winds around 322 km/h. Laboratory rotating-fluid experiments can produce polygonal flows, including hexagons.
entries.project_boundary: The hexagon is an atmospheric flow pattern, not a rigid cube, artificial megastructure or physical evidence of occult Saturn symbolism.

entries.literal: In string theory, T-duality relates certain string backgrounds/compactifications so that descriptions involving a compact radius R can correspond to dual descriptions involving an inverse-scale radius. The equivalence depends on the string-theory structure and is not ordinary geometric inversion.
entries.project_boundary: Useful as an example that apparently different scale descriptions can encode equivalent physics in a specific theory. It does not imply spiritual above/below, large/small or inner/outer states are physically dual.

entries.literal: Mirror symmetry relates pairs of Calabi-Yau compactifications / associated supersymmetric conformal field theories in ways that exchange geometric data while preserving relevant physical content.
entries.project_boundary: Mirror/Twin language may use this as a formal comparator only. Human twins, symbolic opposites and theological Father/Son relations are not thereby string-theory mirror pairs.

entries.term: Entanglement and emergent geometry in holography
entries.literal: In AdS/CFT research, quantum entanglement structure is deeply related to geometric quantities in a specific gauge/gravity duality setting. This is a theory-specific relation between quantum field theory and gravitational geometry.
entries.project_boundary: It is not evidence that ordinary social relationships, language or spiritual bonds literally generate spacetime.

entries.literal: M-theory is a framework connecting several string-theory descriptions and is formulated with an eleven-dimensional low-energy supergravity limit. The extra dimensions belong to a mathematical/physical theory of fundamental interactions, not to an eleven-step symbolic hierarchy.
entries.project_boundary: A project architecture with eleven levels can be compared numerically or structurally only after stating that no physical identification follows from the shared number.

promotion_tests: Name the physical object or field being modeled.
Specify the governing equation or mechanism.
State the scale/regime in which the model is intended to apply.
Name an observable that differs from a baseline model.
State what result would count against the claim.
Keep symbolic analogy in a separate field from empirical status.
